title: 第六章 浦江暗影第七章 军官窥伺
lines: 民国二十五年的初秋，黄浦江的水汽里总裹着股说不清的黏腻。白日里商船往来，汽笛声搅得江面不得安宁，可一到深夜，雾霭像块浸了水的棉絮，沉甸甸压下来，连岸边的路灯都晕成了一团模糊的光晕。
凌峰站在“归燕楼”二楼的露台上，指尖夹着支没点燃的烟。楼下的石库门弄堂里，更夫敲着梆子走过，“笃笃”声混着远处赌场散场的喧哗，是这乱世里难得的“烟火气”。可他心里那点刚被新婚暖意焐热的安稳，自三天前那个水晶人影凭空出现在后厨后，就像被投入江中的石子，再没平静过。
“还没睡？”刘佳琪披着件薄衫走过来，将一杯温热的茶塞进他手里。她的指尖触到他的手，轻轻捏了捏——这是他们从小就有的默契，她知道他但凡皱眉，定是心里搁了事。
凌峰转过身，借着窗内漏出的灯光看她。成婚不过半月，她鬓边还别着那支他从国外带回的珍珠钗，此刻在夜色里泛着柔和的光。他喉结动了动，把到了嘴边的话又咽了回去。青口的话像根刺，扎在他心头：“飞船就藏在江底，离岸边不过三里地。那芯片是导航核心，没它，我们走不了；可要是被别的东西盯上……”
“你在想那个‘水晶人’的话，对吗？”刘佳琪却像看穿了他，抬手替他理了理微乱的衣领，“那天在后厨，我虽吓得躲在你身后，可他说的每一个字，我都听见了。”
凌峰一怔，猛地握住她的手：“佳琪，这太危险了。青口说，丢了芯片的不止他们，还有别的‘东西’在找。我本想……”
“本想瞒着我，自己扛？”刘佳琪打断他，眼底闪过一丝嗔怪，更多的却是坚定，“凌峰，从穿开裆裤时你爬树掏鸟窝摔断腿，是我跑遍三条街喊来郎中；后来你去法国，每封家信都是我替你爹娘念的。二十五年了，你哪件事能瞒得过我？”
她的声音很轻，却像块石头砸在凌峰心上。他望着她清亮的眼睛，忽然觉得那些关于外星、飞船的恐惧，好像被这双眼睛里的光冲淡了些。他叹了口气，把茶杯放在栏杆上，从怀里摸出那枚玉佩。
月光恰好从云层里钻出来，落在玉佩上。这枚被他从小戴到大的玉观音，此刻看来确实有些不同——观音的衣褶处，有一点极细微的银亮，不仔细看，只会当是玉石本身的棉絮。“青口说，这就是芯片嵌着的地方。”他指尖拂过那点银亮，“它能感应到我的情绪，那天在后巷跟地痞动手，我气急了，它就亮了。”
刘佳琪凑近看了看，忽然“咦”了一声：“你看这观音的底座。”
凌峰依言翻转玉佩，底座边缘竟刻着一行极小的字，不是常见的落款，倒像是些歪歪扭扭的符号，像是小孩子用指甲划出来的。“这是……”
“我爹以前收过些老物件，”刘佳琪蹙着眉回忆，“他说有些古玉会被人刻上暗记，要么是藏宝的标记，要么是避祸的符。可这符号……我从没见过。”
正说着，江面上忽然传来一阵奇怪的声响。不是轮船的马达声，倒像是有什么巨大的东西在水下搅动，闷沉沉的，带着股让人牙酸的摩擦声。两人同时屏住呼吸，朝江面望去。
雾霭里，靠近岸边的地方，水面竟像被一只无形的手推开，掀起一道不算高的浪。浪头过后，雾气似乎更浓了些，连那点路灯的光晕都被吞了进去。紧接着，一阵极轻微的“滋滋”声从远处传来，像是什么金属在摩擦。
“是……是飞船？”刘佳琪的声音有些发颤，下意识往凌峰身边靠了靠。
凌峰却摇摇头。青口说过，他们的飞船启动时是无声的，只会有能量波动。可刚才那声音……他忽然想起青口提到的“别的东西”——那些追踪他们而来的“猎手”。
“回屋。”他一把攥住刘佳琪的手腕，转身就往楼梯口走。刚到楼梯拐角，就听见楼下传来“咔哒”一声轻响，像是有人碰了餐厅的后门。
“归燕楼”的后门通着后厨，平日里除了采买的伙计，从没人会走。凌峰示意刘佳琪躲进楼梯下的储物间，自己则抄起墙角一根用来顶门的粗木棍，放轻脚步往下走。
后厨的窗户没关严，夜风灌进来，吹得挂在墙上的围裙轻轻晃动。后门的门闩是插上的，可门缝里，却透进来一道极细的光——不是灯笼或电灯的光，是种发蓝的、冷冰冰的光。
凌峰的心提到了嗓子眼。他记得青口说过，朗斯星人的能量光是温和的白色，而猎手的能量……是蓝色。
他握紧木棍，正想出声喝问，那道蓝光忽然消失了。紧接着，后门“吱呀”一声被推开条缝，一个黑影闪了进来。
那黑影很高，瘦得像根竹竿，穿着件不合时宜的黑色长风衣，帽檐压得很低，看不清脸。他走路没有声音，像脚不沾地似的，径直走向凌峰平日里放杂物的柜子——那柜子里，就藏着青口暂时栖身的一个铁皮盒。
凌峰屏住呼吸，猛地从阴影里冲出去，木棍带着风声砸向那黑影的后背。可木棍像是打在了一块铁板上，“嘭”的一声震得他虎口发麻，黑影却连晃都没晃一下。
content_en:
In the early autumn of the 25th year of the Republic of China, the water vapor in the Huangpu River was always filled with an indescribable stickiness. During the day, merchant ships come and go, and the sound of whistles disturbs the tranquility on the river. But late at night, the fog is like a piece of water-soaked cotton wool, pressing down so heavily that even the street lights on the shore are dimmed into a blurry halo.
Ling Feng stood on the terrace on the second floor of "Guiyan Tower" with an unlit cigarette between his fingertips. In the Shikumen alley downstairs, the watchman walked by banging his clapper, and the sound of "tuk-tuk" mixed with the noise of the casino closing in the distance was a rare "firework" in this troubled world. But the peace in his heart that had just been warmed by the warmth of the wedding had never been calmer since the crystal figure appeared out of thin air in the kitchen three days ago, like a pebble thrown into the river.
"Still not asleep?" Liu Jiaqi came over wearing a thin shirt and put a cup of warm tea into his hand. Her fingertips touched his hand and squeezed it gently - this was a tacit understanding they had had since childhood. She knew that whenever he frowned, he must have something in mind.
Ling Feng turned around and looked at her through the light leaking from the window. They had only been married for half a month, and she still wore the pearl hairpin he brought back from abroad on her temples, which was glowing softly in the night. His Adam's apple moved and he swallowed back the words that came to his lips. Qingkou's words were like a thorn in his heart: "The spaceship is hidden at the bottom of the river, only three miles away from the shore. That chip is the navigation core. Without it, we can't leave; but if we are targeted by something else..."
"You're thinking about what that 'Crystal Man' said, right?" Liu Jiaqi seemed to have seen through him, raising her hand to straighten his slightly messy collar, "That day in the kitchen, even though I was so scared that I hid behind you, I heard every word he said."
Ling Feng was startled and suddenly held her hand: "Jiaqi, this is too dangerous. Qingkou said that they were not the only ones who lost the chip, there were other 'things' they were looking for. I wanted to..."
"You wanted to hide it from me and carry it yourself?" Liu Jiaqi interrupted him, with a flash of anger in her eyes, but more of a determination, "Ling Feng, ever since you climbed a tree and dug out bird's nests and broke your leg when you were wearing crotchless pants, I ran three streets to call the doctor; then when you went to France, I read every letter home for your parents. For twenty-five years, what can you hide from me?"
Her voice was very soft, but it hit Ling Feng's heart like a stone. He looked into her clear eyes, and suddenly felt that his fears about aliens and spaceships seemed to be diluted by the light in these eyes. He sighed, placed the tea cup on the railing, and took out the jade pendant from his arms.
The moonlight just happened to come out of the clouds and fall on the jade pendant. This jade Guanyin that he has worn since childhood does look a little different now - there is a very subtle silvery shine in the folds of Guanyin's clothes. If you don't look carefully, you will just think it is the cotton of the jade itself. "Qingkou said, this is where the chip is embedded." His fingertips brushed the silver light, "It can sense my emotions. That day when I was fighting with gangsters in the back alley, it lit up when I got angry."
Liu Jiaqi took a closer look and suddenly said "Hey": "Look at the base of this Guanyin."
Ling Feng turned the jade pendant over as he was told, and there was actually a line of very small words engraved on the edge of the base. It was not a common signature, but more like some crooked symbols, like a child's fingernails. "This is..."
"My father used to collect some old objects," Liu Jiaqi recalled with a frown, "He said that some ancient jades would be engraved with secret symbols, either as a mark for hiding treasures or as a talisman to avoid disaster. But this symbol... I have never seen it before."
As he was talking, a strange sound suddenly came from the river. It wasn't the sound of a ship's motor, but rather like something huge stirring underwater. It was a dull, grinding sound that made people's teeth hurt. The two of them held their breath at the same time and looked towards the river.
In the mist, near the shore, the water surface seemed to be pushed away by an invisible hand, causing a wave that was not too high. After the wave passed, the fog seemed to be thicker, even the halo of the street lamp was swallowed up. Immediately afterwards, a very slight "sizzling" sound came from the distance, like something metal was rubbing.
"Is...is it a spaceship?" Liu Jiaqi's voice was trembling, and she subconsciously leaned closer to Ling Feng.
Ling Feng shook his head. Qingkou said that their spacecraft is silent when it starts, and there will only be energy fluctuations. But that sound just now... He suddenly remembered the "other things" Qingkou mentioned - the "hunters" who were following them.
"Go back to the house." He grabbed Liu Jiaqi's wrist, turned around and walked towards the stairs. As soon as I reached the corner of the stairs, I heard a soft "click" from downstairs, as if someone touched the back door of the restaurant.
The back door of "Guiyan Tower" leads to the kitchen. On weekdays, no one except the shopping assistants would leave. Ling Feng signaled Liu Jiaqi to hide in the storage room under the stairs, while he picked up a thick wooden stick in the corner that was used to prop up the door, and walked down quietly.
The kitchen window was not closed tightly, and the night breeze came in, causing the apron hanging on the wall to sway slightly. The latch of the back door was locked, but a very thin light came through the crack of the door - not the light of a lantern or an electric lamp, but a blue, cold light.
Ling Feng's heart rose to his throat. He remembered Qingkou saying that the energy light of the Langsi people was mild white, while the energy of the hunters... was blue.
He gripped the stick tightly and was about to shout a question when the blue light suddenly disappeared. Immediately afterwards, the back door creaked open, and a dark figure flashed in.
The dark figure was tall and as thin as a bamboo pole. He was wearing an untimely black long windbreaker, and the brim of the hat was so low that his face could not be seen clearly. He walked without making a sound, as if his feet were not touching the ground, and walked straight to the cupboard where Ling Feng usually kept his miscellaneous items - in that cupboard was hidden a tin box where Qingkou temporarily stayed.
Ling Feng held his breath and rushed out of the shadows. The wooden stick hit the black figure's back with a sound of wind. But the stick seemed to hit an iron plate
